title: Ice Folk rework: the Frost Wyrm, the Walrus and the Snow Golem, with their portraits, in the fixed faction colours of direction-ice-folk

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only these parts: the brown and taupe scales of the body, legs, belly and tail become snow white scales, colour #f4f1e8, shaded pale warm grey #c4baa8; the orange and red eyes become bright ice blue; any red or orange mark on the face becomes white. Keep the shaggy white mane, the dark slate snout and claws, the wings with their ice blue edges, the ice crystal spikes along the back and tail, the pose, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: frost-wyrm-a is the right chibi drake in flight (a big round head, spread wings, ice spikes down the tail, the tail tip lowest), but its body is a muddy taupe-brown and its eyes orange: the edit makes it a white frost drake with ice-blue eyes.

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only: the pale blue shading of the snow on the right side becomes warm light grey, colour #c9c0b0, so no snow is blue; the purple mouth becomes black; the tan patch behind the boulder becomes white snow. Keep the ivory snow, the ice crystals, the slate boulder, the eyes, the pose, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: snow-golem-e is the right golem (a chunky bare snow body, a pebble grin, ice crystals in its shoulders, the slate boulder held up in one fist), but its right side is shaded pale blue, which the accent step turns into a saturated blue rim, its mouth is purple and a tan patch shows behind the boulder.

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only the shadows of the snow: every cool blue and blue-grey shadow tone on the body, arms, legs and head becomes a warm light taupe grey, colour #c4b8a6, darker #a0937f in the deepest folds, so no snow is blue or grey-blue. Keep the ivory white lit snow, the bright blue ice crystals, the dark slate boulder, the black eyes and mouth, the shapes, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: snow-golem-e-shade fixed the mouth but kept the blue shade on the golem's right side; this is the wording that fixed the Yeti's blue-grey fur shade (yeti-fur-b).

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only the shadows of the snow: every blue and blue-grey shadow tone on the body, arms, legs and head becomes a pale neutral grey like shaded snow, colour #d2d4d6, darker #aeb1b5 in the deepest folds, so no snow is blue; the lit snow becomes pure white #fbfbf8. Keep the bright blue ice crystals, the dark slate boulder, the black eyes and mouth, the shapes, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: snow-golem-e-warm has no blue left, but its warm taupe shade makes it a beige dough figure rather than snow; this asks for neutral grey snow shade, below the accent step's saturation floor (0.2), so the step leaves it grey.

recipes.editInstruction: Recolour only these parts: the grey top of the head and the dark navy neck and chest become snow white scales, colour #f4f1e8, shaded pale warm grey #c4baa8; the tan horns and ear frills become pale ivory bone #eadfc8; any orange near the eyes becomes white.
